content: Hello! You’ve reached the IT help desk. How can I support you today?
I’m having trouble logging into my customer account. Can you help me reset my password?
Of course! Please go to the secure login page and click on 'Forgot Password'.
I see the link. It’s asking for my username and registered email address. Should I enter both?
Yes, please enter your username and the email address you used when creating your account.
Done. Now it sent me a code to my email.
Perfect. Please check your inbox for the verification code and enter it in the prompt on the reset page.
I entered the code. Now it wants me to create a new password.
Great! Go ahead and choose a strong new password, then click the 'Submit' button to finish.
All set. I’m able to log in now. Thank you!
